The Cafe Latte was superb. It was obvious that good quality beans were used. My …

Matteo has become my favourite place for hot cocoa. The level of sweetness is just perfect. It is pure love in a cup. Retails for just Rs. 200 for a grande size. Please visit Matteo if you area genuine hot cocoa lover or you love coffee. The latte here is great too.
The pasta was sub par, the lemon iced tea was justttt lemon, coffee was overly sweet. The fries was the only thing that was edible and tasty.
